description: Eleven apps for people who do not code. No accounts, no internet needed, nothing to install.
author: Priyanshu Agarwal

apps.name: nanoHome
apps.what: One front door for every nano app on this computer

apps.name: nanoLaama
apps.what: Talk to an AI on your own computer — offline, no account, no key

apps.name: nanoDoc
apps.what: Drop in a document, ask it anything — answers show the paragraph they came from

apps.name: nanoLearn
apps.what: Drop a spreadsheet, get an answer machine

apps.name: nanoSay
apps.what: Have anything read out loud by the voice already in your computer

apps.name: nanoPick
apps.what: Find your files by saying what you remember

apps.name: nanoTune
apps.what: Your music, one page, no account — point it at a folder and press play

apps.name: nanoWrap
apps.what: The programs already on your computer, with buttons

apps.name: nanoShell
apps.what: Any program at all, with words instead of flags

apps.name: nanoGit
apps.what: Your folder, kept safe and put online, without learning git

apps.name: nanoDesk
apps.what: Every nano-style app you have, one click away

apps.name: nonoForge
apps.what: Pick a card, answer two questions, press one button — a working app

engine_room.name: nanollama.c
engine_room.what: The inference engine in ~1400 lines of C

engine_room.name: nanobrain
engine_room.what: Pre-training from scratch in raw PyTorch

engine_room.name: nanoforge
engine_room.what: The offline studio: build, train, export

engine_room.name: nanorl
engine_room.what: SFT and DPO alignment for tiny models

promises: Plain words everywhere, honest about what it does not know
Nothing is destroyed without being asked
